Node.description_en: The cluster node information, including the node ID, associated node group, instance type, and status
Node.description_zh: 集群节点信息，包含节点标识、所属节点组、实例规格和状态

AutoRenew.description_en:
Specifies whether auto-renewal is enabled for the node. Valid values:
true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is disabled
AutoRenew.description_zh:
节点是否自动续费。取值范围：
true：已开启自动续费。
false：未开启自动续费
AutoRenew.title: 节点是否自动续费。

AutoRenewDuration.description_en: The auto-renewal duration for the node
AutoRenewDuration.title: 节点自动续费时长。

AutoRenewDurationUnit.description_en: The unit of the auto-renewal duration for the node
AutoRenewDurationUnit.description_zh: 节点自动续费时长单位
AutoRenewDurationUnit.title: 节点自动续费时长单位。

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the node was created
CreateTime.title: 节点创建时间。返回状态使用。

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the node expires
ExpireTime.title: 节点过期时间。

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type, which corresponds to the ECS instance type. You can call the [DescribeInstanceTypes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html） operation of ECS to retrieve available instance types
InstanceType.description_zh: 实例类型。对应ECS的实例类型，您可以通过调用ECS服务的[DescribeInstanceTypes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25620.html）获取可用的实例类型
InstanceType.title: 实例类型。

MaintenanceStatus.description_en:
The O&M mode status. Valid values:
ON: The node is in O&M mode.
OFF: The node is not in O&M mode.

An empty value indicates that the node is not in O&M mode
MaintenanceStatus.description_zh:
运维模式状态。取值范围：
ON：处于运维模式。
OFF：处于非运维模式。

为空表示处于非运维模式
MaintenanceStatus.title: 运维模式状态。

NodeGroupId.description_en: The ID of the node group
NodeGroupId.title: 节点组ID。

NodeGroupType.description_en:
The type of the node group. Valid values:
MASTER: master node group
CORE: core node group
TASK: task node group
NodeGroupType.description_zh:
节点组类型。取值范围：
MASTER：主节点组类型。
CORE：核心节点组类型。
TASK：计算节点组类型
NodeGroupType.title: 节点组类型。

NodeState.description_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:
Pending: The node is being created.
Starting: The node is starting.
Running: The node is running.
Stopping: The node is stopping.
Stopped: The node is stopped.
Terminated: The node is terminated
NodeState.description_zh:
节点状态。取值范围：
Pending：创建中。
Starting：启动中。
Running：运行中。
Stopping：停止中。
Stopped：已停止。
Terminated：已终止
NodeState.title: 节点状态。

description_en: Queries the nodes in an EMR cluster
kebab_example: aliyun emr list-nodes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodes

parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in a single request. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The list of node group IDs
parameters.name: node_group_ids

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`

fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag This parameter is optional and can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。非必填，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或者```https://```
fields.name: value

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned in the current request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
MaxResults.title_en: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。

NextToken.description_en: The token that specifies the starting position for the next read operation. If this parameter is empty, all data has been read
NextToken.description_zh: 下次开始读取的位置。返回空时表示数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_en: 返回读取到的数据位置。
NextToken.title_zh: 返回读取到的数据位置。

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the request conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的总记录数
TotalCount.title_en: 本次请求条件下的数据总量。
